name: --help

options.description: Causes less to automatically exit the second time it reaches end-of-file

--force
options.description: Forces non-regular files to be opened

options.description: Like -i, but searches ignore case even if the pattern contains uppercase letters

name: -j
--jump-target
options.description: Specifies a line on the screen where the "target" line is to be positioned

name: -J
--status-column
options.description: Displays a status column at the left edge of the screen

--lesskey-file

--no-lessopen

--long-prompt
options.description: Causes less to prompt verbosely (like more), with the percent into the file

--LONG-PROMPT
options.description: Causes less to prompt even more verbosely than more

name: -n
--line-numbers
options.description: Suppresses line numbers

name: -N
--LINE-NUMBERS
options.description: Causes a line number to be displayed at the beginning of each line in the display

name: -o
--log-file
options.description: Causes less to copy its input to the named file as it is being viewed

--prompt

--raw-control-chars
options.description: Causes "raw" control characters to be displayed

options.description: Like -r, but only ANSI "color" escape sequences and OSC 8 hyperlink sequences are output in "raw" form

--squeeze-blank-lines
options.description: Causes consecutive blank lines to be squeezed into a single blank line

--chop-long-lines
options.description: Causes lines longer than the screen width to be chopped (truncated) rather than wrapped

--tag

--tag-file

--version
options.description: Displays the version number of less

--hilite-unread
options.description: Temporarily highlights the first "new" line after a forward movement of a full page

--HILITE-UNREAD
options.description: Like -w, but temporarily highlights the first new line after any forward movement command larger than one line

--tabs=

name: -X
--no-init
options.description: Disables sending the termcap initialization and deinitialization strings to the terminal

name: -y
--max-forw-scroll
options.description: Specifies a maximum number of lines to scroll forward

name: -z
--window
options.description: Changes the default scrolling window size to n lines

name: --quotes
options.description: Changes the filename quoting character

name: --tilde
options.description: Normally lines after end of file are displayed as a single tilde (~)

options.description: Specifies the default number of positions to scroll horizontally in the RIGHTARROW and LEFTARROW commands

options.description: Disables sending the keypad initialization and deinitialization strings to the terminal

options.description: This option changes the interpretations of options which follow this one

options.description: Enables the colored text in various places
